name: desktop-v2026.10.1
body:
- the first signed build: open it like any Mac app, no Terminal step
- bise updates itself when you quit it, or while you're away
- the inbox has its own page: what waits for you, then what you answered
- drop an image or a PDF on the composer, agents read it
- `⌘K` opens any agent, live or archived
- the right bar shows the artifacts and timers of the agent in view
- pages open next to the thread, with your notes on them

## fixes

- the tab says the folder's name
